newsitem.title: FINLAND: Raisio jumps on result but trade thin.
newsitem.headline: Raisio jumps on result but trade thin.

text.p: Shares in Finnish food and chemicals group Raision Tehtaat Oy rose sharply early on Thursday after the company reported better than expected 1996 earnings, brokers said.

At 1055/0855 GMT, Raisio traded at 440.00 markka, up 16.00 markka or almost four percent but just off a 442.00 earlier peak, but trade was less than six million markka and brokers said it was too early to say whether this was the trend.
"Expectations for billions of markka in profits are in the future and they said nothing about that," one broker said, adding he saw no reason for the initial gain.
Raisio's profit before extraordinary items was 166 million markka, up from 141 million in 1995. Forecasts ranged from 128 million to 204 million and the median was 148 million markka.
Brokers said they were waiting for more news and analyst views after briefings.
